description: This PHP class defines the DayOfMonthField for cron scheduling, handling special day-of-month expressions like 'L' for last day and 'W' for nearest weekday, including methods for evaluating satisfaction of a date, incrementing dates, and validating input values.

classes.name: DayOfMonthField
classes.description: A class representing the day-of-month field in cron expressions, with logic for special characters and date calculations.

methods.name: getNearestWeekday
methods.description: Calculates the nearest weekday to a given day in a specific month and year.

methods.name: isSatisfiedBy
methods.description: Checks if a given date satisfies the cron day-of-month condition.

methods.name: increment
methods.description: Moves the date forward or backward by one day, adjusting time accordingly.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the cron expression value for the day-of-month field.
